changelog:
Restore the verified Builder ID profileless compatibility path: Kiro IDE/AmazonQ Q generation and Q MCP may run without a cached profile; Runtime and CodeWhisperer remain profile-bound, and fixed profile endpoints still require fallback to be enabled.
恢复已验证的 Builder ID 无 Profile 兼容路径：Kiro IDE/AmazonQ Q 生成端点与 Q MCP 可在没有缓存 Profile 时尝试；Runtime 与 CodeWhisperer 仍要求 Profile，固定 Profile 端点仍需开启回退才能切换兼容端点。
